passive_description.localized:
Increases Break Intensity by <lv>{0}</>.
Seals Arc: Black Tome with two chains by default. Unleashes 1 chain each time any character on the team casts a Support Skill. Makes Arc: Black Tome available when all two chains are unleashed.
Arc: Black Tome — Summons the Black Tome for <lv>{1}</>s. Designates an enemy every <lv>{2}</>s. Increases the wearer's Chaos DMG dealt to designated enemies by <lv>{3}</>. Deals Chaos DMG equal to <lv>{4}</> of the wearer's ATK to designated enemies when they take Break Damage.
passive_description.source:
倾陷强度提升<lv>{0}</>。
常态下调弧·「黑之书」被两根锁链封锁，每当队伍中任意角色释放「援护技」时，可以解除一根锁链。两根锁链全部解除后可使用调弧·「黑之书」。
调弧·「黑之书」：召唤黑之书，黑之书存在于场上<lv>{1}</>秒，每<lv>{2}</>秒指定一个敌人，装备者对被指定的敌人造成的暗属性异能伤害提高<lv>{3}</>。当被指定的敌人受到倾陷伤害的时候，黑之书对其造成装备者<lv>{4}</>攻击力的暗属性异能伤害。

tested_hypotheses: Black Tome grants the wearer its frozen Break Intensity points unconditionally (60/67/74/81/88 at T1..T5, bIsPercent=false); the points are staged in the GearProcConfig::BlackBookBreak configuration.

The staged +BI points join the break damage zone additively as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 5); this is asserted as core zone math, and the adapter-to-zone link has no runtime consumer yet, so it is a return condition.

The points do not enter ordinary damage or gauge accumulation: an ordinary scenario with the proc equipped produces damage identical to the proc-less baseline, and gear zone modifiers report zero damage_bonus and zero atk_percent.
The BI ratio is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor; the multiplicative misreadings 1.60/1.74/1.88 are rejected by the hand-derived zone-math oracles 1.10, 337/300, 86/75.

Arc: Black Tome summon (buff_BlackBook2_CD 20.0s), enemy designation cadence (buff_BlackBook2_CD2 5.0s), Chaos DMG bonus to designated enemies (0.20-0.36), and Black Tome attack damage (2.0-3.2x ATK) are observed but not modeled; chain sealing/unleashing has no engine representation.
Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
